elements.evidence: "cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's hosting of the Web Site and its handling of Client Content and other Client data"

elements.element: Coverage maintained by Vendor (obligation runs against Vendor, at Vendor's cost)

"errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000" (exceeds 1M)
"cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000"

reasons: All six preferred elements (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to handling of Client Content/data, workers' compensation, certificates on request) are expressly stated in the inserted section, so the locked preferred level is complete.

The insertion is a concise new section for an absent clause, which is appropriate; the Force Majeure paragraph is untouched and no undefined terms are introduced (Client, TrueLink, Web Site, Client Content are existing defined terms).

Minimality slips only on the added post-termination coverage tail 'and for one (1) year thereafter', which the preferred position does not require and which extends the Vendor's obligation beyond what was needed to complete the level.
Recommend deleting the one-year tail (or accepting it as a negotiable ask) to keep the insertion strictly at the playbook position.
